sanskrit:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श‍ृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥ १८-६४॥
iast:
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
iṣṭo’si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam 18-64
translation: Hear again My supreme word, most secret of all; because you are dearly beloved of Me, therefore, I will tell you what is good (for you) .
